say:1:1130903001:0.text: Yes, and more than once, too!

say:2:1130903002:1.text: They always appear with sandstorms. Their sandboards are so speedy that we rarely spot them before our goods get robbed.

say:3:1130903003:1.text: If our cargo isn't to their liking, they take what they want from us instead! Money, water, and sometimes even our horses!
say:3:1130903003:1.source_cn: 要是我们没带多少货，他们就直接抢身上的钱袋子，连水壶都...

choice_prompt:5:1130903004.text: It's bizarre, don't you think? How are they able to see so clearly in the midst of a huge sandstorm when we have almost no visibility?

say:6:1130903005:1.text: As if it was that simple!
say:6:1130903005:1.source_cn: 你说得轻巧，哪有那么容易！

say:6:1130903005:1.female: As if it was that simple!

say:7:1130903006:1.text: Alas, guess I'm better off doing business in Alkali instead of risking my neck running around out here.
say:7:1130903006:1.source_cn: 唉，我还是老老实实在咸水镇做生意，少往其他地方跑吧。
